issues.description: README links the ASR config at conf/train/... but the file lives at conf/...
issues.detail: README.md points to ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml; the actual path is ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml. The link 404s and the README is wrong about the recipe it documents. Fix the path to match reality.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh checks for unzip but does not exit when missing
issues.detail: Under set -euo pipefail, the script prints a warning if unzip is absent and then continues to invoke unzip later, dying with an obscure error. Either exit non-zero on the precondition failure or remove the check; a half-enforced precondition is worse than none.

issues.description: Usage block prints but does not exit on bad argc, falling through to realpath of an unset arg
issues.detail: When $# is out of [1,2], the script cats usage and falls through into realpath $1. With set -u and a missing positional, this either crashes obscurely or, worse, succeeds with the wrong frame. Add exit 1 after the heredoc so precondition violations terminate cleanly.

issues.description: Unquoted realpath arguments under set -u break on whitespace or empty values
issues.detail: extract_dir=$(realpath $1) and realpath ${2:-$extract_dir} are unquoted. Paths containing spaces split into multiple words, and an empty positional crashes under set -u. Quote them: realpath "$1" and realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}". Latent crash waiting on a path with a space.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh violates its name's contract: never downloads and silently continues on missing archives
issues.detail: The script is named download_and_untar.sh, matching the ESPnet recipe contract (download if absent, then extract). This implementation only extracts and returns success when archives are missing. Either rename to extract.sh or honor the supertype: fail loudly when archives are absent. Breaks substitutability across the egs2/ recipe family.

issues.description: Hard-coded utterance counts couple the recipe to one dataset snapshot
issues.detail: data.sh aborts if wc -l does not match magic numbers (22467/3208/6072/29386/38924). Any benign upstream change to the public dataset breaks the recipe with a wc mismatch and no actionable path forward. Either warn instead of aborting, or document the provenance of the counts so future maintainers can update them.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a conventional ESPnet bootcamp recipe with honest results but sloppy supporting shell. The dominant theme is unenforced preconditions in download_and_untar.sh: missing unzip warns instead of exiting, bad argc prints usage then falls through, and unquoted realpath arguments crash under set -euo pipefail. Documentation contracts are also broken — the README links a config path that doesn't exist. Secondary concerns include the script violating its own name's contract (never downloads) and hard-coded utterance counts that will break on any dataset refresh. Fixes are small and obvious; recipe is sound once the contracts are honored.
